# Infinite Diagnosis

Infinite Diagnosis: A cross-domain reasoning engine that mines global scientific literature for non-standard breakthroughs across all biological domains.

evidence_and_limit: Keyword catalog clusters plus PubMed query adapter; not cross-domain breakthrough discovery. Offline fixture probe does not establish current global coverage.

text: Infinite Diagnosis generates experimental roadmaps and biomarkers, enabling clinicians to find solutions for complex cases using AI.

# Tissue Eng

Tissue Eng: A design tool for 3D bioprinting strategies, suggesting biomaterials and cell types for creating vascularized tissue models.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Curated tissue/cell/bioink selection and size/vascular heuristics exist; not manufactured 3D tissue validation.

text: It calibrates printing parameters for scaffolds and simulates mechanical responses under physiological stress.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Printer starting parameters, stress/fatigue formulas exist; oxygen profile independently reproduces [100,75,100], repeats. Specific printer calibration and mechanical testing required.
